subject: Datadog compact storage benchmarking & add-on pricing
messages:
From: Marin Kovač <marin@datadog.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>; Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: pricing@datadog.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compact storage benchmarking POC + add-on pricing

Hi Soojin / Laura,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, attached is a small benchmarking plan we can run to quantify cost savings if you enable Datadog's "compact storage" add-on for log ingestion (the plan intentionally focuses on tail-latency and retention economics). The attachment includes the sample queries, expected tokenization behavior, and a minimal infra test harness so we can produce apples-to-apples numbers against your current pipeline.

High-level notes: 
- Expected per-token storage reduction depends on compression window; we typically see 20-35% on JSON-heavy logs.
- There is a small CPU uplift during ingestion (~5-10%) but read latency is generally unaffected for queries under 1M events.
- Licensing model: base ingestion + compact storage add-on (monthly) + retrieval egress fee for long-term archives. See price sheet attached.

If you want, we can run a 2-week POC using a sampled subset of your prod stream (5–10m events/day) and deliver metrics, a cost delta, and an implementation playbook. Pricing for the POC itself is refundable against a committed annual add-on contract.

Files attached: dd_compact_storage_benchmark_v1.xlsx, datadog_price_sheet_addons_Q3.pdf

Best,
Marin Kovač
Enterprise Solutions Engineer, Datadog
marin@datadog.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Marin Kovač <marin@datadog.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compact storage benchmarking POC + add-on pricing

Marin — thanks, that looks concrete and helpful. Quick checklist from our side before we greenlight a POC: 

1) Data access model: we need to know exactly what subset you will pull and whether you need decrypted payloads (we prefer to keep keys internal).
2) Sample size and sampling method — Ben, can you advise if 5–10M/day is representative for our peak windows?
3) Cost comparison baseline — Vivek, can you confirm the current monthly $/GB baseline we should use (including egress & storage)?
4) Timeline: we'd like to run the POC in the first half of October if possible.

Also pls include any compliance evidence (SOC2 section) related to the add-on and whether logs processed for the POC will appear in Datadog's retained aggregates.

If acceptable, we'll circulate an SOW with a refundable POC fee and the target success criteria (>=15% net storage $ reduction at parity query latency).

— Soojin
Sr. Product Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 12:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compact storage benchmarking POC + add-on pricing

Sooj, quick notes from infra/cost: 

- 5–10M/day would cover our normal ingestion; peak bursts hit ~18M/day for 30–45m windows. For a realistic POC we should include one burst window to validate CPU/latency behavior.
- Current baseline (avg over last 3 months): ingestion+storage+retention ~= $1.12/GB/month; add ~0.08/GB for retrieval on monthly access patterns. I'll attach a short CSV excerpt to the ticket (internal).
- Success criteria: 15% net reduction at parity read p95 and no increase in tail query errors.

I'll coordinate sampling with the Observability team and provision a masked subset for Datadog access (no PII).

— Ben
Principal Site Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Marin Kovač <marin@datadog.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: pricing@datadog.com; procurement@datadog.com
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compact storage benchmarking POC + add-on pricing

Thanks all — appreciate the detail. Attached is an updated price sheet that includes: a refundable POC line item ($6,500), annual add-on list pricing, and a committed-discount table for 12/24/36 month terms. Notes: 

- Committed 12mo gives 10% off add-on list; 24mo = 15%; 36mo = 20%
- POC refundable credit applies if Redwood purchases the add-on within 90 days of POC completion.
- Procurement: we can accept a light SOW + standard Datadog MSAs. If you need tighter data residency language, that goes to legal (happy to loop in the right folks).

Attachment: datadog_price_sheet_addons_Q3.pdf

On compliance: Datadog confirms the add-on processes logs in the same environment as base logs; SOC 2 scope is identical, and we can provide the specific sub-control evidence (I'll send via secure link to procurement).

Would you like us to schedule the POC for week of Oct 4?

Best,
Marin

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Marin Kovač <marin@datadog.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compact storage benchmarking POC + add-on pricing

Marin — thanks, that all looks good. Next steps from Redwood: 

1) Vivek and Ben will finalize the mask/sample and confirm dates by Friday 9/11.
2) Laura, please open an internal SOW request and loop Legal/Procurement with the price sheet attached; mark it refundable against the POC.
3) Marin, please send the secure SOC 2 sub-control evidence link to procurement@datadog.com and we'll route it to our security team.

If we get signoff on the sample by 9/11 we can confirm week of Oct 4 for the POC. Vivek— can you own the SLAs/acceptance criteria doc so we can attach it to the SOW?

Thanks — looking forward to measurable numbers here.

— Soojin
